ZIMMERMANN-NSA.title: The Zimmermann Telegram
passages_read: Printed pp. 43–45; p.44 image visually inspected because OCR is poor. Diplomatic 0075 intercept and more extensively reconstructed 13040 onward version, Mexican copy and source protection.
ZIMMERMANN-NSA.scope: Historical account and translated investigation. Does not support additive encipherment in the actual telegram or equating diplomatic books with SKM/HVB.

ZIMMERMANN-PAGE-1917.title: Ambassador Page to the Secretary of State, telegram 5747
passages_read: 24 February 1917 telegram text, including the proposed alliance and contemporary account of copies purchased in Mexico.
ZIMMERMANN-PAGE-1917.scope: Contemporary diplomatic report; account of intelligence sourcing reflects what Britain disclosed, not the entire interception history.

ZIMMERMANN-NARA-2016.title: The Zimmermann Telegram
passages_read: Opening and events leading to American entry; intercepted telegram contributed alongside other causes.
ZIMMERMANN-NARA-2016.scope: Archival retrospective, not evidence that the telegram alone caused war.

HMML-ETHIOPIA.title: HMML Global Operations: Ethiopia
passages_read: Read collection and language descriptions. Evidence of manuscript heritage, not of the invented substitution model.

UNICODE-ETHIOPIC.title: The Unicode Standard, Chapter 19, §19.1 Ethiopic

CTC-JHU.title: Morse Code in Chinese
passages_read: Read collection account of Dian bao xin bian (1909): earlier Danish contribution, Shanghai refinement in 1872 and Zheng Guanying revision in 1881.

WADSWORTH-FRIEDMAN.title: Friedman Collection, Folder 515: Wadsworth cipher apparatus
passages_read: Read PDF pp.1–2 and 7–8: 1817 device description; uncertain operational use; 1949 Hamden return correspondence.

CRYPTOMUSEUM-FIALKA.title: M-125 Fialka: examined machines and variants
passages_read: Read introduction and models: 1956, ten 30-contact wheels, opposite movement, country configurations, punched-card substitution, M-125-3M 1965. No conclusion about unknown classified cryptanalysis.

CRYPTOMUSEUM-KL7.title: TSEC/KL-7 ADONIS, POLLUX
passages_read: Read introduction, examined-machine operation and procedures: 1952 introduction, eight wheels/seven moving, re-entry, phased withdrawal. Do not adopt contradictory page declassification dates.

CRYPTOMUSEUM-M209.title: M-209 / CSP-1500: examined machine
passages_read: Read introduction, operation, versions: letter selector, crank and printed tape; about 140,000 manufactured. Historical attack timings depend on depth and conditions.
